boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, campus-adjacent Geneseo destinations on Main Street and nearby downtown corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Village Park: use the public green
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Route 20A corridor
cards.notes: Start at the Main Street edge of campus, then use the benches, gardens, picnic tables, lawn, or Veterans’ Memorial for a daylight pause.
cards.short_summary: A civic park with outdoor amenities at Main Street and Route 20A.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Park is at Main Street and Route 20A and has picnic tables, benches, gardens, lawn, a Veterans’ Memorial, and a historic log cabin.
cards.access_notes: Public park; check the Village for any event-specific reservation or access details.

cards.title: Bear Fountain: find the Main Street landmark
cards.subtitle: Main Street & Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk to the Center Street intersection and photograph the fountain from the sidewalk while taking in this documented civic landmark.
cards.short_summary: A historic, aesthetic, and cultural landmark at Main and Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village’s plan identifies the Bear Fountain at Main and Center streets as a historic, aesthetic, and cultural landmark.
cards.access_notes: View from public sidewalks at the intersection.

cards.title: Wadsworth Homestead: spot a local historic site
cards.subtitle: South Street / Route 20A corridor
cards.notes: Continue just south of Village Park to see the documented Wadsworth Homestead address and check its own calendar before attending an event.
cards.short_summary: A named historical-site destination on South Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Geneseo lists Wadsworth Homestead as a historical site at 4 South Street in Geneseo.
cards.access_notes: Event access and any fees depend on the specific program.

cards.title: The Geneseo Riviera: check the program
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the venue’s current listings before you go; its rental information documents screenings, concerts, presentations, and other special events.
cards.short_summary: A local venue for screenings, concerts, and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Geneseo Riviera states that its venue is used for concerts, screenings, meetings, presentations, and special events.
cards.access_notes: Admission, schedule, and access vary by event; consult the venue before visiting.

cards.title: County Historical Museum: follow Center Street
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn east from Main Street at the Bear Fountain and look for the museum just beyond the first stop sign on the right.
cards.short_summary: A Center Street museum reached from the Bear Fountain.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s directions say to turn east from Main Street at the Bear Fountain onto Center Street; it is at 30 Center Street.
cards.source_title: Location — Livingston County Historical Society Museum
cards.access_notes: The museum reports free parking and partial accessibility; confirm visiting hours directly.

cards.title: Wadsworth Library: use the downtown library
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to 24 Center Street for a library stop; consult the library directly for current hours, programs, borrowing, and room-use details.
cards.short_summary: The public library is a named Center Street destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Geneseo lists Wadsworth Library at 24 Center Street, Geneseo.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current website or contact it for hours and service availability.

cards.title: Highland Park: use the recreation facilities
cards.subtitle: Highland Road corridor
cards.notes: Take the off-campus loop toward Highland Road and use the park’s documented courts, fields, pavilion, playground, or seasonal ice rink as available.
cards.short_summary: A Highland Road park with several recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village plan identifies Highland Park on Highland Road and lists tennis and basketball courts, fields, a pavilion, playground, and winter ice rink.
cards.access_notes: Facilities and seasonal availability may change; confirm conditions with the Village.

cards.title: Temple Hill Cemetery: take a self-guided history walk
cards.subtitle: Temple Hill Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit during daylight, follow the paths, and use the cemetery’s self-guided tour material to explore documented local and Normal School history.
cards.short_summary: A daylight-accessible cemetery with self-guided historic tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Temple Hill Cemetery offers self-guided tours including Geneseo history and SUNY Geneseo’s early Normal School years.
cards.access_notes: The cemetery says it is open daily from dawn until dusk; remain on paths when possible.

cards.title: Geneseo Methodist Church: orient on the loop
cards.subtitle: Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Use this named nearby establishment as an orientation point while following the university’s listed off-campus bus-stop sequence through downtown.
cards.short_summary: A named establishment on the university’s off-campus bus-stop list.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s bus-stop page lists Geneseo Methodist Church among establishments near its off-campus route stops.
cards.source_title: Bus Stops with Nearby Businesses and Services
cards.access_notes: This card is for route orientation; respect private worship and event access rules.

cards.title: Geneseo Square Plaza: use a named route stop
cards.subtitle: South Street / Route 20A corridor
cards.notes: Use the university’s off-campus route information to locate this named plaza stop, then verify individual businesses and services before making a trip.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza on SUNY Geneseo’s off-campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo’s bus-stop page identifies Geneseo Square Plaza as a stop on its listed route.
cards.source_title: Bus Stops with Nearby Businesses and Services
cards.access_notes: Check the university’s current transportation information and individual destinations before travel.
